d: He resigned. His company said he was gone for good. The board refused to bring him back. But just 11 days later, Jensen Huang walked back into Nvidia to a hero's welcome. His return sent markets soaring and added nearly a trillion dollars to Nvidia's value in a single trading session. But this was no ordinary comeback. Donald Trump personally intervened, the board reversed course, and now Congress wants answers. Why was Trump so invested in bringing Jensen back? And what does this say about the power one man holds over America's AI ambitions? Palki Sharma tells you.
